svg.title: Data mining to trajectory synthesis and quality verification pipeline
svg.desc: Inventory: three top arrow-shaped section headers; left data-mining section with Data Pool database and document cards, blue synthesis icon marked ×8, success line and hard QA pairs database; central Query arrow into pale LLM/tool-set panel with Gemini-like star, LLM text, cycle icon, dashed Tool set area containing search/tool icons, then three horizontal trajectory rows of arrows and colored action/info markers with ellipses and Think/Action/Info legend, plus OpenAI knot icon with two curved feedback arrows; right quality-verification section with dashed checklist panel containing three criteria and green checks, arrow into cold-start database with check badge. Symmetry/equipartition: pipeline is horizontally ordered left-to-right; three trajectory rows and three verification checklist rows are vertically equipartitioned; cylinder databases share a common stacked-ellipse construction style. Confirmed SAM mappings used after native construction: data pool icon, QA database, blue ×8 icon, LLM star/cycle/tool icons, OpenAI icon, cold-start database and check badge.
